summary: Tested Monthly Rewards system for leaderboard: All 17 backend API tests passed. Frontend leaderboard page shows Monthly Rewards section with all prize info (1st/2nd/3rd place rewards). Public endpoints for previous-winners and featured-partner work without auth. Admin endpoints for process-monthly-rewards and monthly-rewards-history require authentication. Email service has both send_leaderboard_winner_email and send_featured_partner_email methods.

minor.issue: When no referrals exist for the month, 'reward_config' is not included in response. Only returned when winners are found. Minor inconsistency in API response structure.

seed_data_creation: No seed data created - tested with existing data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Monthly Rewards system is fully functional. No rewards have been processed yet, so previous-winners and featured-partner return empty/null. To process rewards with dry_run=false, admin needs to POST to /api/affiliates/admin/process-monthly-rewards with dry_run=false query param. Rewards are: 1st ($100 + tier upgrade + featured), 2nd ($50), 3rd ($25). Email templates for winners are in email_service.py.
